title: Combat state (module_data.combat)
description: Schema for a character entity's module_data.combat sub-object under the core/hp-pool-v1 module (ADR-0005 / RFC-0007, RFC-0014). Contract of record: module schema fragments are declarative today (not composed into apply-time validation per RFC-0014 Out of Scope). The HP pool itself lives under module_data.character_sheet.hp (RFC-0007); this object holds combat state that is not a derived sheet field.

death_saves_failed.description: The three-strike death clock (RFC-0014). Advances by one on each failed death save while unconscious at 0 HP; reset to 0 on a stabilizing save or any healing; 3 = dead. Written authoritatively by the engine (not the DM) on a death_save resolve turn.
